 Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver  powerful  solutions.  
 Sumary:

 Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSO units and associated equipment.

 As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.

 Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.

 Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.

 Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.

 Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.

 Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.

 Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.

 Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.

 Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.

 
  Key Competencies:

 
 Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.

 Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.

 Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.

 Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.

 Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.

 Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.

 Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.

 Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands-on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

 
 Qualifications and Experience

 
 Engineering degree is mandatory.

 CREA-RJ accreditation is required.

 Post-Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considere

 Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver  powerful  solutions.  
 Responsibility 

 The Topside Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring that own day-to-day activities and those of own peers are carried out in a safe and healthy manner and that the impact of such activities on the environment is within acceptable limits. The Topside Maintenance Technician working area will be the topside, main deck, engine room and accommodation.

 The Topside Maintenance Technician is responsible for the maintenance of the mechanical equipment that includes valves, pumps, compressors, piping and other devices were the mechanical qualification is required. The Topside Maintenance Technician is responsible to maintain his worksite clean and organized.

 Duties 

 
 Follow Permit to Work procedures to the assigned task or to be executed under his responsibility

 Assist the Lead Topsides Maintenance Tech in all matters related to the safe and efficient operation

 Ensure proper cleanliness and good working condition of all Topside equipment and facilities. 

 Maintain tandem mooring equipment and export hose reel(s).

 Service of export hose and mooring hawser

 Maintain deck equipment, cargo handling equipment, cranes and safety equipment in good working order

 Manage waste and hazardous material management system onboard

 Carry out deck cranes visual inspection 

 Carry out the duties and tasks as specified in the Emergency Response Plan

 
 Furthermore, the Topside Maintenance Technician must perform the work required by his superior and perform tasks according to company procedures, including administrative or operational tasks.

 HSE Responsibility 

 
 Responsible for maintaining a high degree of awareness.

 Lead by doing; setting an example for others.

 Observe and report any unsafe activities, conditions or situations.

 If you observe anything unsafe use the ‘Stop Work’ Policy.

 If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

  

 Disclaimer (Applicable for MY & SG only)

 Referrals for the following roles are excluded from the Employee Referral Programme, though submissions are welcome: Management Committee, Yinson Board Directos, Hiring Managers involved in hiring process, HODs, HR/Cost Centre Owners, temporary staffs, contractors, trainees, former employees, candidates sourced elsewhere in the last year, and immediate family members.

Location : FPSO Anna Nery

 Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver  powerful  solutions.  
 Responsibility 

 The Trainee Topside Maintenance Technician supports the maintenance team in carrying out day-to-day maintenance activities onboard in a safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible manner. 

 The trainee will assist experienced technicians in maintaining top-side and engine room mechanical equipment while gaining practical offshore experience and technical competency.

 The trainee will work under supervision in areas including the topside process area, main deck, utility systems, engine room support areas, and accommodation related mechanical systems.

 Duties 

 
 Assist Topside Maintenance technicians in performing preventive and corrective maintenance activities. 

 Support maintenance activities involving pumps, valves, compressors, piping systems, cranes, hoses, and rotating equipment. 

 Learn and follow Permit to Work (PTW) procedures and company safety regulations.

 Assist in equipment inspections, cleaning, lubrication, and routine operational checks. 

 Help maintain housekeeping standards in workshops and operational areas. 

 Assist in maintenance of export hose systems and mooring equipment.

 Support equipment troubleshooting activities under supervision.

 Participate in emergency drills and carry out assigned emergency response duties. 

 Ensure tools, spare parts, and maintenance equipment are properly handled and stored.

 Report unsafe conditions, equipment defects, or incidents to supervisors immediately.

 Participate in training programs and competency development activities onboard. 

 Perform other duties as assigned by supervisors in accordance with company procedures.

 
 HSSE Responsibility 

 
 Work in compliance with all Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental (HSSE) procedures. 

 Always maintain a high level of safety awareness.

 Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).

 Follow the company “Stop Work Authority” policy when unsafe conditions are observed.

 Contribute to a safe and environmentally responsible working culture onboard.

 Attend safety meetings, toolbox talks, and required training sessions.

 If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!
